build_xl_autoregressive_wrapper: build an XLAutoregressiveWrapper to wrap a transformer net for long-sequence training and generation
generate_text_with_xl_wrapper: generate autoregressive text sequences with start tokens, eos token, and top-k filtering
train_transformer_with_xl_wrapper: train a transformer with chunked forward pass, segment memory, and weighted cross-entropy loss
configure_xl_wrapper_loss: configure XLAutoregressiveWrapper with custom ignore_index and pad_value for sequence labeling
sample_with_temperature_filtering: sample from filtered logits with temperature scaling and top_k or top_p filtering
